content.intro: In this lesson, you will study useful utility classes with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you choose standard APIs that match the meaning and constraints of the data. In this lesson, focus on objects and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A class defines state and behavior; an object is an instance. Encapsulation protects invariants by keeping mutable state private and validating updates through a small public API. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.

common_mistakes.fix: Add an empty, boundary, or invalid case and state the expected behavior before running it.
